title: 第十八章 情第十九章 爱
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
末婚妻啊，冥帝回忆着，夕日红算吗？应该不算吧。
“没有，你看我才多大啊。就是认识了一个会幻术的姐姐。”冥帝实话实说。
“那你喜不喜欢她？”照美冥追问，看她这架式，颇有管家婆的味道。
“喜欢啊，你不会吃醋吧。”冥帝笑道。
“鬼才吃你的醋呢。”照美冥轻哼了一声。
“好了，问题问完了，我们可以走了吧。”冥帝道。
“等等。”照美冥再一次叫住了冥帝。
“又怎么了？尊贵的水影大人。”冥帝无奈问道。
照美冥站在原地，一双秋眸直直盯着冥帝，似乎在犹豫什么。冥帝见状也不急，陪她玩起了大眼瞪小眼的游戏。
“上路吧。”随后冥帝受不了了，伸出手拍拍照美冥，转身往前行去。
“这混蛋。”照美冥咬着唇捂着被冥帝拍过的肩膀，心底涌出一丝难言的甜蜜。
照美冥赶了上去对冥帝道：“照你这样走，要走到猴年马月才能水之国啊。”
冥帝呵呵一笑“一边走路，一边修炼忍术！”
走在了森林之中。
“不愧是火影世界里的森林，每棵树都这么大！”看着自己眼前不知道多高的树，冥帝感叹道。上一世一直生活在城市中，最高的树也没有眼前这棵树那样高。以前看见很高的树只是有两三层楼那么高，而这棵树，冥帝根本就不知道它到底能有多高。七层楼？八层楼？
如果就是这一棵树这么高的话，冥帝也不会有这样的感慨。但是这个森林里可以说每棵树都这么高，有的甚至更高，这才让冥帝发出了这样的感慨，不得不说忍者世界的环境保护的不错。
虽然忍者的战斗中，有时候一个忍术就会破坏一大片森林，但是忍者的生态环境还是那么好。
“不知道忍者的世界中那些发电什么的是不是用雷遁。”冥帝又开始胡思乱想了。照美冥一直走的很安静！
不再想自己无聊的想法，冥帝想着要开始自己查克拉性质变化的修炼了。对于查克拉性质，形态变化，冥帝还不是很熟练。
波风水门留下来的卷轴之中除了螺旋丸，还有飞雷神之术！影分身之术！

每天冥帝和照美冥停下来休息的时候，冥帝就让自己的十个影分身每人拿一片叶子在手里，然后5个来修炼风属性的查克拉性质变化，5个来修炼火属性的查克拉性质变化。
冥帝想着先修炼风和火！
风属性的查克拉性质变化就是像动漫中那样，利用自己的查克拉来割开树叶。
而火属性的查克拉性质变化修炼和风属性的查克拉性质变化修炼可以说是大同小异的。为什么这么说呢，因为火属性的查克拉性质变化修炼的第一步就是让这片树叶点燃。
让自己的影分身开始查克拉性质的变化修炼，而冥帝自己也开始和水影照美冥学习起来了水遁之术，作为水影，照美冥在水遁忍术上，有着一般忍者所没有的经验。
时间就这么一点一点的过去，不知不觉中冥帝和照美冥走在这个森林里已经走了三个月了。虽然冥帝一直在赶路，但是边修炼边赶路还是非常慢的，而且有时候还会遇到一些小麻烦。这些小麻烦就是会遇到一些野兽啊，有时候会遇到一些小强盗。
冥帝当然不会放过这么好的实战机会，所以每次冥帝都不会轻松的杀死他们，而是让他们陪自己多玩一会。
content_en:
My last wife, Emperor Hades recalled, does the red sunset count? It probably doesn't count.
"No, look how old I am. I just met a sister who knows magic." Emperor Ming told the truth.
"Then do you like her?" Terumi Mei asked, looking at her attitude, she looked like a housekeeper.
"I like it, you won't be jealous, right?" Emperor Hades smiled.
"The devil is jealous of you." Terumi Mei snorted.
"Okay, now that we've asked the questions, we can go." Emperor Hades said.
"Wait." Terumi Mei called Emperor Hades again.
"What's wrong? Your distinguished Lord Mizukage." Emperor Ming asked helplessly.
Terumi Mei stood there, staring at Emperor Hades with a pair of autumn eyes, seeming to be hesitating about something. Emperor Hades was not in a hurry when he saw this, and played a game of big eyes and small eyes with her.
"Let's get on the road." Then Ming Emperor couldn't stand it anymore, stretched out his hand to take a picture of Mei Ming, turned around and walked forward.
"This bastard." Terumi Mei bit her lip and covered the shoulder patted by Hades, feeling an unspeakable sweetness well up in her heart.
Terumi Mei rushed up and said to Emperor Hades: "If you go this way, you won't be able to reach the Kingdom of Water until you reach the year of the monkey and the month of the horse."
Emperor Hades chuckled, "Practice Ninjutsu while walking!"
Walking in the forest.
"As expected of the forest in the Naruto world, every tree is so big!" Emperor Hades sighed as he looked at the tall trees in front of him. In my last life, I had been living in a city, and the tallest tree was not as tall as the tree in front of me. I have seen tall trees before that were only as high as two or three stories, but Emperor Hades had no idea how tall this tree could be. Seven floors? Eight floors?
If this tree was as tall as this one, Emperor Hades would not have such emotion. But it can be said that every tree in this forest is so tall, and some are even higher. This made Emperor Hades express such emotion. It must be said that the environment of the ninja world is well protected.
Although in ninja battles, sometimes a single ninjutsu can destroy a large forest, the ecological environment of ninjas is still so good.
"I wonder if those who generate electricity in the ninja world use thunder escape." Hades Emperor began to have random thoughts again. Terumi Mei walked very quietly!
No longer thinking about his boring thoughts, Emperor Hades thought about starting the practice of changing the nature of his chakra. Emperor Hades is not very proficient in chakra properties and shape changes.
Among the scrolls left by Namikaze Minato, in addition to the Rasengan, there is also the Flying Thunder God Jutsu! Shadow Clone Technique!
Every day when Hades and Terumi stopped to rest, Hades asked each of his ten shadow clones to hold a leaf in their hands, and then 5 of them would practice chakra properties of the wind attribute, and 5 would practice the changes of the chakra properties of the fire attribute.
Emperor Hades wanted to practice wind and fire first!
The change in chakra properties of the wind attribute is to use your own chakra to cut leaves like in the anime.
The practice of changing chakra properties of fire attribute and the practice of changing chakra properties of wind attribute can be said to be similar. Why do you say this? Because the first step in practicing the change of fire chakra properties is to ignite the leaf.
Let his shadow clone begin to practice the change of chakra properties, and Hades himself also began to learn the water escape technique with the Mizukage Terumi Mei. As a Mizukage, Terumi Mei has experience in the water escape ninjutsu that ordinary ninjas do not have.
Time passed like this little by little, and unknowingly, Emperor Hades and Mei Terumi had been walking in this forest for three months. Although Emperor Hades has been on the road, traveling while practicing is still very slow, and sometimes he encounters some minor troubles. These little troubles are encountering some wild beasts and sometimes some little robbers.
Of course, Emperor Hades would not let go of such a good opportunity for actual combat, so every time Emperor Hades would not kill them easily, but would let them play with him for a while longer.
